10-24 20:43:54.088  2509  2509 E dex2oat32:       It describes how the class loader chain should be built in order to ensure

10-24 20:43:54.088  2509  2509 E dex2oat32:       loader 'i+1' will be the parent of class loader 'i'.
10-24 20:43:54.088  2509  2509 E dex2oat32:       The compilation sources will be appended to the classpath of the first class
